Based on the evidence provided, Google acquired Wiz for approximately $32 billion in an all-cash deal announced on 2025-03-18 [Source: ev-1]. The primary strategic reason for this acquisition was to close the security gap with competitors AWS and Azure under the leadership of Thomas Kurian at Google Cloud [Source: ev-1].

Regarding what the deal signaled about the cloud-security market, it indicated a focus on cloud-security consolidation as the next battleground in the "cloud wars," driven by AI-driven cloud adoption [Source: ev-1]. Additionally, the transaction marked the largest acquisition in Google's history [Source: ev-1].
